set.body:
Outcome: make mlvtoolbox measurements comparable across drawings and sampling choices, then support reproducible whole-contour stimulus subset selection with measured experimental controls.

Planning baseline: d83ed952fdc9f639b98e849b0d8697259894de46; user review and accepted refinements from this conversation. Existing mlv-parity-perf owns ongoing parity/performance work and is not replaced or reparented. Its completion or an explicit scoped handoff precedes source changes in the prediction guard. Inspect live reservations before implementation. This epic records planned work; it does not claim implementation, release qualification, publication, or scientific superiority.

Delivery order:
1. Immediate correctness patch: mlv-spec-guard.
2. Release A: mlv-feature-spec, mlv-invariance-suite, mlv-curvature-estimators, mlv-branch-estimators, mlv-feature-integration, and mlv-release-a.
3. Release B: mlv-designer-benchmark, mlv-subset-optimizer, mlv-designer-workflow, and mlv-release-b. Designer implementation waits for qualified Release A and a frozen benchmark.
4. Graph work: mlv-graph-fixtures and mlv-graph-descriptors.
5. Bounded research: mlv-voronoi-spike. A documented no-go is an acceptable research outcome; a production backend is outside this epic.

Binding decisions:
- Feature metadata must be bound to training models or supplied explicitly; checked prediction rejects missing or incompatible specifications. Any legacy unchecked path is explicit and warns.
- Freeze feature units, bins, weights, normalization, estimator identities/versions, and measurement scales. Record pixels per degree of visual angle and extraction settings. Separate semantic compatibility from input-specific provenance; differing calibrations may produce compatible physical features.
- Keep estimator='mlv2023' as the default for one release. Offer explicit turning and arclength methods; arclength is the main new curvature method. No automatic default switch later without a documented migration decision. Preserve numeric parity fixtures; metadata fixtures may evolve with dedicated assertions.
- Exact geometric invariance and sensitivity to geometry-changing tracing/simplification are different acceptance claims. Establish the suite and tolerances before estimator implementation.
- Designer v1 selects whole contours only. Set-level matching is primary; per-drawing matching is optional and may be infeasible. Use declared additive constraints and L1 histogram deviations. Recompute all reported properties on outputs. No transformation search, nonlinear junction/MAT optimization, or spatial-union optimization in v1.
- Freeze benchmark drawings, tolerances, objective, baselines, and compute budgets before building the optimizer. Distinguish proven infeasibility from budget exhaustion and report achieved imbalance and optimality evidence.
- Separate Release A correctness work from Release B design risk. Graph work and Voronoi research do not block either release gate.

Known witnesses: unchanged L contour mean curvature is 6, 3, then 6 deg/pixel after collinear subdivision and reversal. Its two-segment integrated value is 180 degrees for a single 90-degree turn. The implementation duplicates the final interior turn, not every interior turn, and omits closed-contour wraparound. Straight-branch mirror scores depend on sample count through (1-1/n)^10. Default length-bin meanings change with canvas size.

Completion: all 14 child outcomes have evidence, Release A and B gates are satisfied independently, graph claims pass their frozen synthetic tests, and the research spike has a time-bounded decision report. Preserve adverse outcomes and limitations; do not close the epic merely because its tickets exist. Record exact source revisions, fixture identities, commands, results, and limitations. Current task authorizes planning and tracker writes, not implementation, dependency installation, publication, or deployment.
set.title: Reliable mid-level vision measurements and controlled stimulus construction
